prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a parking lot collision. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1123; do not mention it.)
text:
This letter confirms that our firm now represents the interests of our client in connection with the parking lot collision described in the claim you have opened. Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to our office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, mail, email, or in person. If your insured or any representative of your company has already been in touch with our client, please let us know so we can address it.

We ask that you provide the bodily injury and property damage liability limits under the policy issued to your insured for this loss, along with a copy of the declarations page. Our client has sustained injuries that are still being evaluated, and we need this information to assess the full scope of available coverage.

Please also take steps now to preserve all evidence relating to this incident. This includes photographs, dash camera or surveillance footage, vehicle data, repair estimates, adjuster notes, recorded statements, and any written reports. Routine deletion or disposal of these materials should be suspended until this matter is resolved. We look forward to your prompt written confirmation that these requests have been received and will be honored.
